summary: Constellation Energy Generation LLC filed an 8-K to disclose a $2.2B multi-tranche senior notes offering comprising $750M 4.55% notes due 2029, $600M 4.80% notes due 2032, and $850M 5.30% notes due 2036. Proceeds will repay short-term borrowings and for general corporate purposes. This ordinary debt issuance and refinancing is not a special situation; it is a routine capital markets transaction. No deal terms apply.
